verdict.rationale: Aleph is an FP&A SaaS platform, so API parity with the UI is a fair question. The evidence documents no public Aleph API, though. "Anything with an API" refers to ingesting data from external sources, the OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and the agent, Slack and spreadsheet features are UI or add-in surfaces, not a programmatic API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
